title: Darlington SMR Faces Cost Overrun; Construction Interest Remains Recoverable

meta.summary:
Ontario Power Generation and the partnership developing four small modular reactors at Darlington have reduced the partnership’s proposed 2027-2031 revenue requirement to about $400 million from $2.7 billion. 
 The post  Darlington SMR Faces Cost Overrun; Construction Interest Remains Recoverable  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
